title: Daily digest: Level 3 Elevated
message: No new Gulf attacks found overnight; Hormuz still shut, oil eased to about US$90. Elsewhere: Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan say hackers stole some customer data via outside suppliers (a hack; mostly US customers, card numbers reportedly safe, no sign Australians hit). Do: ignore texts about a 'card security issue'; check only in your bank's app.
